messages:
Alex Chen: Heads up - customer ACME-Prod on Private VPC reports a billing delta. Dashboard shows ~1.2M tokens for 03/14-03/15 but invoice charges ~1.8M. Can support triage?
Samir Patel: @Alex which agent version and deployment? any recent restarts or upgrades?
Alex Chen: Private cluster (us-west-2), metering-agent v2.3.1 (installed via package). Agent mode: offline-buffer=disk, max-buffer=5GB. Last agent restart 2026-03-14 01:12 UTC (rolling reboot during maintenance).
Katie Morales: tagging billing: we need raw counts + agent logs. If events were buffered offline then flushed, invoice might include duplicates if seq handling failed.
Alex Chen: Sharing snippets:
```
$ redwood-meterctl status
agent_version: "2.3.1"
uptime: 36h
buffer_mode: disk
buffered_events: 1.1M
sent_events_24h: 650842
last_flush: 2026-03-14T02:05:11Z
ntp_offset: +3m12s
```
Also tail of /var/log/redwood-metering/audit.log shows a run of repeated seq_ids around the flush time.
meter-agent-bot: NOTICE: buffer flush attempted at 2026-03-14T02:05:10Z -> 2026-03-14T02:05:50Z, bytes_written=3.2GB, result=partial_write, reason="write timeout"
DevOps SRE: Disk metrics for node-12 show disk_util peaked 99% at 02:04 UTC. I saw increased IO from backup job that coincided with flush.
Samir Patel: So hypothesis: disk pressure caused partial flush and agent retried, creating duplicate send attempts with overlapping seq windows? Does agent ack handle idempotency on server side?
Katie Morales: Billing backend deduplicates by request_id but if agent retries with new request_id and server accepted overlapping payloads (without seq dedupe) we could double-count.
Alex Chen: I grep'd the audit for seq patterns. Example lines:
```
[2026-03-14T02:05:10Z] seq=125901 request_id=abcd1234 payload_tokens=512
[2026-03-14T02:05:12Z] seq=125901 request_id=abcd1234 retry=1
[2026-03-14T02:05:50Z] seq=125901 request_id=efgh5678 payload_tokens=512
```
That last one is the duplicate with new request_id after partial write error.
billing-bot: ALERT: potential double-bill risk flagged. Opening billing investigation ticket BL-2026-128.
DevOps SRE: We need to know how many unique seq ids were duplicated. I can run a quick scan on the node's audit.log but need permission from customer. Can support get consent?
Alex Chen: Customer gave permission for logs for triage earlier in the PM. I'll paste sanitized counts shortly.
Samir Patel: Also note ntp_offset +3m12s - clock skew could reorder events when server-side dedupe relies on timestamps. Combined with retries we have a plausible path to inflated counts.
Alex Chen: Sanitized summary after scan:
- total_buffered_events_at_flush: 1,102,334
- unique_seq_ids_sent_once: 642,810
- duplicate_seq_ids_detected (same seq, diff request_id): 219,456
- lost_events (agent reported dropped after repeated failures): ~12,100
Katie Morales: Thanks. From invoice vs dashboard delta, difference ~600k tokens. The duplicate count roughly aligns (219k events * avg 3 tokens/event ~657k). We'll likely issue credit.
DevOps SRE: Immediate mitigations: (1) bump agent to v2.4.0 (idempotent flush + stronger backoff + disk-pruning), (2) enforce NTP and systemd-timesyncd, (3) set buffer_mode=memory+disk hybrid to reduce long-lived disk queues.
meter-agent-bot: Scheduled upgrade task created: upgrade_job_id=upg-78321 target_version=v2.4.0 window=2026-03-16T03:00Z
Katie Morales: Billing will provisionally credit the customer while we validate server logs. @billing-bot keep BL-2026-128 open until we confirm exact billed tokens to reverse.
billing-bot: BL-2026-128 created. Owner: Katie Morales. Status: investigating. Estimated time to validate: 48h.
Alex Chen: Follow-up for SRE: I captured the agent core logs and attached stack traces to the ticket. Also added a note: agent config had old rotate policy (keep 30d) and disk prune disabled.
Samir Patel: Post-mortem points: offline-buffering needs safe sequencing that survives partial_write. Add integration test for partial write + retry dedupe. Also add metric for "duplicate_seq_detected" and alert when >10k in 1h.
DevOps SRE: Agreed. I'll file infra task INFRA-569 to add disk pressure alert on metering nodes and require node-level reservation for meter writes.
Katie Morales: Customer-facing message drafted: apologize, explain cause (disk pressure + retry duplication), next steps (credit pending, agent upgrade scheduled, ntp check). PM review before send.
Alex Chen: I'll coordinate PM and send once billing confirms credit. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
